message.content:
Keysight Technologies Inc reported revenue of $1.85 billion for the quarter ended 2026-07-31, growth of 36.54% on a year earlier, with net income of $397 million, a gross margin of 65.87% and a net margin of 21.51% [D1]. Earnings per share of 2.82 exceeded the estimate of 2.16 by 30.56%, and earnings per share grew 63.95% on a year earlier while net income grew 107.85% [D1]. The Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1.35 billion, up 43.09%, and income from operations of $458 million, up 86.18%, while the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group reported revenue of $501 million, up 21.60%, and income from operations of $155 million, up 68.48% [D1]. Total segment income from operations of $613 million was up 81.36% on a year earlier, and revenue rose 7.51% on the quarter before [D1].

Management guided the fourth quarter of 2026 to revenue of $1.93 billion to $1.95 billion and to earnings per share of 3.34 to 3.40 on approximately 172 million diluted shares, with the mid point of the revenue range representing growth of approximately 37% [D1]. The company reported total assets of $11.92 billion and shareholders equity of $6.57 billion at 2026-07-31, against net debt of $141 million [D1]. The 2026-08-18 report was followed by a session on 2026-08-19 in which the shares moved -6.32% [D2]. Management said the supply environment is less flexible than a year earlier, called the supply chain the governor of near-term revenue for the next several quarters, and described the supply situation as likely to be nonlinear [D3]. Management also said the one-time tariff impacts this year would not repeat [D3].

The bull case already written rests on revenue of $1.846 billion, up 36.54%, net income of $397 million, up 107.85%, and total segment income from operations of $461 million, up 97.01% [D1]. It also rests on management saying demand is far exceeding the ability to supply and that the pipeline continues to grow [D3]. The bear case already written points to the decline of 13.98% over the five sessions to 2026-08-24 against a group median gain of 1.64% over the same stretch [D5]. The trailing price to earnings of 45.89 sits far above the forward price to earnings of 20.66, so the valuation depends on the guided earnings step-up being delivered [D5]. Analysts pressed on whether demand is sustainable and whether supply constraints are limiting guidance, and management said supply would govern the ability to convert demand into revenue while demand is not the limiter [D3].

The close of 333.42 is above the 20 day average of 330.47, the 50 day average of 326.21 and the 200 day average of 289.31, and the trend state is described as an uptrend [D5]. That close sits below an immediate resistance edge of 366.41, with the nearest support band running from 332.78 down to 311.27 [D5]. Keysight Technologies Inc and the Centre for Assuring Autonomy at the University of York announced a research collaboration to advance the safe deployment of artificial intelligence in software-defined vehicles, focused on practical methods for validating AI systems and generating safety evidence under ISO/PAS 8800 [D7]. Members of management will participate in the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on 2026-09-11 and in the 2026 Truist Technology Symposium on 2026-09-15 [D6].
